system.specialAbility:
You become Trained in Diplomacy and Stealth, and you become Trained in a relevant Lore of your choice.

Example Lores include Lore of your homeland, Lore of a displaced community, Borderlands Lore.
system.description: A judgment, a feud, or a change of rulers made your home somewhere you could no longer remain. You learned to seek welcome carefully and leave before hospitality became suspicion.
